label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
@ReneeK_Meyerland Renee, this is Thu, the owner of Lotus Garden. First, I am sorry your toe got infected and that you were in pain. I really mean that. You have been coming to us for two years and I never want you to leave my salon and end up at urgent care.

I'm not here to fight with you. But a lot of people are reading this now, so I want to say what happened from our side.

You came in Saturday, October 24 for the deluxe pedicure. Your tech was Vy. She is my niece and she has been licensed for three years. She was born here in Houston. She speaks English, she is just shy and quiet with people. She read this thread and she is taking it very hard.

During the pedicure you asked her to cut the cuticle more because you like it very clean. Vy told you she didn't want to cut too much, and you said it was fine, you always get it done that way. I'm not saying this to blame you. I'm saying it because the two of you did talk about it and she tried to be careful.

About how we clean, since people are asking. Every metal tool goes through the autoclave and comes out in a sealed pouch that we open in front of the customer. The file and buffer are new for each person and you take them home with you. The tub gets a new plastic liner every single time. The state inspected us in August this year and we passed with no violations. The paper is on the wall and anybody can come read it.

When you came back on November 2 and showed me your toe, I did not shrug. I offered you the full $45 back, and I also offered to pay your urgent care copay if you bring me the receipt. You asked for $300 cash and free pedicures for one year. That is the part I said no to.

The refund and the copay are still there for you. Nothing changed. Please call me at the salon or come by when it's quiet, and we can sit down and talk, just you and me. I would like that much more than doing this online.

You said you filed with the state. That is your right, and the inspector is welcome any day.

@dave_in_gulfton I understand why people worry, but your comment hurt me the most. We are not all the same. I opened this salon in 2007 after working for my aunt, and I have been doing nails in Houston for 19 years. In all that time I never had one infection complaint. If you or your wife want to come see how we do things, the door is open. You don't have to buy anything.

@MarisolB thank you for saying what you have seen with your own eyes. It means a lot to me and to Vy.

Thu
Lotus Garden Nails

---

Thu, I didn't have the salon phone number, so add it after "call me at the salon" if you want it in the post. I left out her husband, as you asked.

reasons: The appended note addresses Thu as the assistant rather than continuing the owner's post.
